title: Concern
description: TOGAF-sourced justification archetype — Architecture Concern. Defines the property vocabulary for capturing stakeholder concerns that drive architecture decisions and governance priorities. Rootless archetype — used to type concern records in governance justification. TOGAF mapping: Concern (Stakeholder Management, Architecture Requirements specification — the interests that stakeholders have in the architecture). Source framework: TOGAF (Stakeholder Management, Architecture Governance).

category.description: Concern classification. RISK = potential negative outcome. REQUIREMENT = must-have capability. CONSTRAINT = non-negotiable boundary. ASSUMPTION = unverified premise. DEPENDENCY = external factor. TOGAF mapping: Concern categorization in Architecture Requirements Specification.

priority.description: Priority level reflecting impact on architecture decisions. Drives Architecture Requirement prioritization.
